independence: Developer-authored material benchmark grounded in the tracked HCA FY2025 Form 10-K bundle. It has not been independently validated and must not be described as independent ground truth.
rule: Expected credibility and credit_direction labels are frozen in cases.json. Do not tune implementation rules on these cases and then report them as held out. A passing scripted/mocked run is not proof of real-world performance.
normalisation: Each passage was located by converting the source HTML to text (strip tags, unescape HTML entities, collapse runs of whitespace to single spaces). A verification step confirms each passage substring is present in the normalised text of its cited file.
